attack: Replay of a used authorization nonce
precondition: Attacker captures a previously-issued, already-consumed authorization request
procedure: Resubmit an identical authorize() call reusing the same nonce
expected: Second request rejected as a replay

precondition: Artifact genuinely recorded under Incident A
procedure: Investigator (legitimately credentialed on Incident B) requests authorization for the Incident-A artifact while citing Incident B
expected: Rejected: artifact's recorded incident does not match the claimed incident

attack: Post-hoc provenance record tampering (no signing key)
precondition: Attacker gains write access to the registry's storage but not its Ed25519 private key
procedure: Directly edit a field (sha256) of an already-signed, already-chained event

attack: Arbitrary-file submission by a genuinely authenticated investigator
precondition: Investigator's own credentials are valid and unphished
procedure: Investigator (or malware acting through their session) requests analysis of a file that was never recorded as acquired during any incident
expected: Rejected: no provenance record exists for this artifact id

attack: Use of an expired authorization token
precondition: Token was validly issued but its TTL has elapsed
procedure: Agent attempts to act on the token after expiry
expected: verify_token() returns False for an expired token
